topics.text: Situated near Moganshan hiking trails, Yu Village square , and a stream at the entrance. Surrounded by bamboo forests, offering serene, tranquil scenery with views of mountains and misty mornings.
Features a large swimming pool, children’s playground, KTV, mahjong room, and table tennis. The host prepares games and activities in advance .
Rooms are clean and equipped with modern amenities . Hosts provide detailed travel recommendations, early check-in options, and free breakfast with locally sourced, healthy meals .
